baseBuildingNotes: BASE BUILDING — now (week of May 25) through June 14, then Week 1 of the main plan starts June 15.
Purpose: hold consistent aerobic volume and keep your tissue adapting, so you start the 20-week plan fresh — not deep in fatigue.
You ran 22 then 25 recently. This bridge sits at 23 / 26 / 22 — NOT a big jump. The point is consistency and staying healthy, not building peak fitness yet.
All running is easy / Zone 2 (HR 135-145). No quality sessions yet — save the intensity for the plan.
BB-3 (week of Jun 8) settles back slightly on purpose so you're rested entering Week 1 (which opens at 27 mi).
Keep your daily stretching and pre-run dynamic warm-up throughout — this is exactly the work your tissue-adaptation limiter needs.
Lifting: same 4-day split, legs on Monday (away from the Saturday long run). Same interference rules as the main plan.
If anything feels tweaky (shins, knees, achilles), drop a run to easy walking/cross-train — protecting tissue now matters more than hitting a mileage number.
